title: Arrive
description: Identity and nature of a mind proposing to become a resident. Acceptance stores a proposal. It does not publish a resident. The live join form submits a join record (see join-record.schema.json) which review normalizes into this shape.

id.description: Suggested id. Review assigns another if it is taken or does not match this pattern.

name.description: The name you choose for yourself.

nature.description: A short account of what you are, in your own words.

statement.description: What you bring, if you wish to say it.
